tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description:
Run the full test suite and build to confirm both bug fixes integrate cleanly.

1. Run `bun test` — all tests must pass.
2. Run `bun run build` — must produce `dist/ralph` without errors.
3. If anything fails, diagnose and fix the issue.
tasks.notes: 736 tests pass, build produces dist/ralph in 126ms. Both bug fixes from tasks #1 and #2 integrate cleanly.
